sentences.text: Belemnacanthus is a member of the class Placodermi, a group of armored fish.
Eastman formally described the genus Belemnacanthus in 1898.
Before this correct identification, the fossil was successively described as a spine of an elasmobranch, an agnathan, and an antiarch.
It belongs to the family Holonematidae.
This animal lived during the Middle Devonian, specifically in the Givetian stage, within the Eifel region of Germany.
